note: Hotspot geometry for the W.2 Clubhouse room. Coordinates are in master-image pixel space (image_width x image_height); components scale to the rendered size. HOTSPOT ORDER IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TAB/READING ORDER - a spatial walk of the room (left->right, foreground before background), asserted by the schema test. Wiring types: route (href, {id} = league canonical id; gated destinations enforce their own bounce), pending (dignified modal), inert (hover acknowledgment only). plate = optional transparent object layer placed over the master at its in-scene position; null where no clean plate has landed (hotspot drawn on the master, no parallax). The banner carries a curved runtime text layer (SVG textPath baseline + rotation, geometry in image px; text supplied at render time, never baked into art).
